title: Pricing & Profitability
core_problem: Independent nail technicians face a related cluster of problems around pricing & profitability — e.g. client price negotiation, fear of raising prices, income/expense tracking for tax.
desired_outcome: A shared outcome across member problems: Hold firm, fair pricing. Raise rates without losing clients. Stay tax-ready year round.
primary_question: Do real people experience this problem, what does it look like, what outcome do they want, what have they tried, what remains unsolved?
